question: When Otto fought Lye in Pristella, he used the Divine Protection of Soul Language to gain the cooperation of the Water Dragons. Under what conditions did he get them to cooperate?
answer:
Since they understood that Pristella was in a crisis, there was the precondition of dispelling that threat.

At the same time, he must have offered mutual benefits... likely negotiating working conditions or tempting them with food. Each Water Dragon has different preferences—some like eating, while others like slacking off and sleeping. So he counseled them one by one, and though they were verbal promises, he responded with full intention to fulfill them all. For the surviving Water Dragons, he probably followed up properly afterward.
